title: the documented key-minting scripts (scripts/mint-key.mjs ALL_SCOPES, scripts/demo/seed-demo-server.mjs) never grant the `join-rules` scope, so a freshly minted key opens /join-rules read-only and every PUT/POST is 403
evidence: ALL_SCOPES omits 'join-rules'. In the browser a key without that scope loads the editor with Save disabled (qa/evidence/browser-checks-2026-10-12/screenshots/join-rules-5-readonly.png); saving required a key carrying the extra scope. Not run against the real API (no DB), derived from source plus the page behaviour.
fix_direction: add 'join-rules' to the minted scope lists or document a separate mint step

title: the Ask page cites only whole sessions (a link to /sessions/<id>); no speaker or timestamp is shown with the answer's citation, which the live-check brief expected
